Affinities a prime vestige can carry (design/01: a prime delivers a talent and 1+ affinities; more affinities is rarer and worth more). Brent 2026-10-11: fire, earth, wind and lightning beside water. Affinities are NOT tied to the talent - they decide which skills you can learn and are rolled separately when a prime is offered (see balance.json 'primes' and PrimeRoll). prime_default is only what a character gets when nothing was rolled (tests, bots, old saves). 'kit' is the three abilities a character with that affinity starts with: a ranged attack, a melee strike, a movement skill. Labels, descriptions and kits are ours [MODEL]. reflux_shed_mult_combat scales how fast that affinity's reflux sheds while something is trying to kill you (lightning: 0 - only an Overload grounds it). damage_per_reflux (fire's Heat, design/05 2.2): every hit tagged with that affinity is multiplied by 1 + damage_per_reflux x its reflux / 100, so the reflux ring is a second damage bar. slipstream: this affinity earns pips by moving (balance.slipstream). reflux_shed_mult_moving / _standing: in a fight its reflux sheds that much faster while you move and that much while you stand (wind: 3x and not at all). rear_bonus (wind's Lee): a hit tagged with this affinity that lands on an enemy's back does that much more again, on top of the ordinary rear bonus. stone: this affinity raises standing stone (balance.stone). reflux_shed_mult: its reflux sheds that much as fast, always (earth: half - it makes little and keeps it). GENERATED (2026-10-22 build): all 16 affinities. kit = the draft's three starters (ranged, close, movement); reflux_tier and rule (the one rule, as text) from the draft. The rule as data keys, read by the shared systems: light_mult {dark, lit} (a hit tagged with it, by the light where the target stands), unseen_in_dark (Dark hides you), per_metal_class (more per metal class the target wears), through (ignores front block and shields), held_blood (Blood's store), living_only (nothing to the unliving), hale_mult (above half health), dying_mult (below half), corpse_lie_s (corpses lie this long while you hold it), growth (Nature's patches), needs_seen (Dream: the target must see you or be asleep), bonus_vs_status {status: fraction}, status_time_vs {status: mult} (its statuses last longer on those), times_flesh (Disease: times the target's flesh), marks_adrift (Water: a shove that ends leaves Adrift). kind / parents / role (the affinity framework, design/affinities/framework.md, Brent 2026-10-24): 'base' (the eight a character is created with) or 'hybrid' (offered at ascension when a parent is held), a hybrid's two base parents, and its one-line role; from skill_tables.LINEAGE. A listed affinity with no draft (Holy, Unholy) is not emitted.

water.label: Water
water.desc: You decide where everyone stands. Every skill shoves, and what is shoved into something breaks on it.
water.rule: Water moves bodies: every water skill shoves, drags or sets up a shove, and a shoved body that hits something is Crushed.

fire.label: Fire
fire.desc: You get hotter, and so does everything near you. Your own heat is your damage - right up to the moment it locks.
fire.rule: Fire runs on its own heat: fire reflux is a damage multiplier, and fire skills build it, scale with it, or spend it.
fire.role: Burst caster - big hits, spreading burns

earth.label: Earth
earth.desc: Slow, heavy and sure. You raise stone, stand behind it, and break it over whoever is on the other side.
earth.rule: Earth builds stone that stays: its skills raise, use or break your stone, wind up Braced, and break poise.

wind.label: Wind
wind.desc: You are only dangerous while you are moving. Run and the pips fill; stand to think and they drain.
wind.rule: Wind is paid for by moving: running earns Slipstream pips, and every wind skill spends (or earns) pips for its real effect.
wind.role: Evasive monk - positioning, rear hits, speed

lightning.label: Lightning
lightning.desc: One target, three touches, gone. Its heat does not bleed off in a fight - only finishing a target grounds it.
lightning.rule: Lightning marks a target and overloads it: every lightning hit leaves Live marks, and the third mark is an Overload that stuns the target and arcs to every other marked enemy within 12 m.

ice.label: Ice
ice.desc: Cold stays. Lay Chill over several casts until they lock solid, then break them with one hard hit.
ice.rule: Cold stays: every ice hit adds Chill, which never wears off by itself; at 5 Chill the target freezes solid, and a frozen thing is Brittle, so the next hard hit Shatters it.

dark.label: Dark
dark.desc: Strongest where the light is weakest. Make your own dark, stand in it unseen, and hit them while they stand in it.
dark.rule: Dark is strongest where the light is weakest: every spot is Lit, Dim or Dark; dark hits do +25% to a target standing in Dark and -20% in Lit, you are Unseen while you stand in Dark, and dark skills make their own Dark.

metal.label: Metal
metal.desc: You work the metal that is already there: armour is your target, and your weapon is your material.
metal.rule: Metal works the metal that is already there: your weapon is its material, so its blows scale with your strike, and an enemy's armour is its target: metal hits ignore front armour and do +25% per metal class the target wears (mailed +25%, plated +50%).

blood.label: Blood
blood.desc: You work blood that is already out: open Bleeding, ride and drink the pools, spend what you hold. Never your own health.
blood.rule: Blood works blood that is already out: its hits open Bleeding, bleeding enemies spill pools on the floor, and you keep what you drink as held blood (up to 10); blood skills spend Bleeding, pools or held blood, never your health.
blood.role: Berserker - spilled life, never your own

life.label: Life
life.desc: Inside living bodies: past armour and shields, hardest on the hale, nothing to the unliving. It mends you fast but wounds slowly.
life.rule: Life works inside living bodies: its harm passes armour and shields and hits the hale (above half health) 25% harder, it does nothing to the unliving, and its healing fills the bar fast but closes wounds slowly.

death.label: Death
death.desc: What has died stays useful: corpses lie longer for you and your skills spend them, and the Dying take more.
death.rule: What has died stays useful: for a Death fighter every enemy corpse lies 20 s and Death skills spend it, and a living target below half health is Dying and takes 30% more from Death.

nature.label: Nature
nature.desc: Plant growth that stays, spreads and grows stronger with age; then feed it or cash it in.
nature.rule: Nature plants growth in the ground that stays, spreads and grows stronger with age (sprout, grown, bloom); its skills plant it, feed it or cash it in.

light.label: Light
light.desc: Light arrives at once along a straight line and stops on the first opaque thing; whatever it touches is Lit.
light.rule: Light arrives at once along a dead straight line and stops on the first opaque thing; whatever it touches is Lit: shown through any cover, with the gaps in its armour open (front armour counts half).

dream.label: Dream
dream.desc: Takes hold only of a mind that can see you, or one asleep. Past armour and shields, harder on the Dazed and the Asleep.
dream.rule: A Dream skill takes hold only of a mind that can see it (you, or the thing you made, inside the target's front arc with a clear line) or that is asleep; it ignores armour and shields, does +30% to the Dazed and the Asleep, and its statuses last half again as long on them. Mindless things - constructs, stone - never feel it.

poison.label: Poison
poison.desc: Doses in one body: the first starts a 6 s clock, the rest add to the bill, and the clock pays it all at once.
poison.rule: Poison puts doses in one body: the first dose starts a 6 s clock, later doses add to the bill but not the clock, and when the clock runs out every dose is paid at once (20 each). It never spreads on its own.
poison.role: Coating - tainted water that pays out later

disease.label: Disease
disease.desc: Lives in clouds that linger and drift; flesh inside catches it. Armour cuts it, shields and facing do not.
disease.rule: Disease lives in clouds that linger and drift; flesh inside them catches Infected. Every Disease hit and tick is multiplied by the target's flesh, so worn armour cuts it and constructs and stone ignore it - but a cloud goes round a shield and does not care which way anyone faces.
